title: Shape the home page
question: Three structures for the home page, all in SchoolChalk on white, all keeping the chronological blog feed. Lock the one that should become the home page, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: The register
options.thesis: The feed is a numbered register; the three topics are its columns, ticked in chalk.
options.viewport: Slim author line, then the register: topic columns as its key, every post a numbered row (No. 07 down to 01) ticked under its topic.
options.risk: Reads as a table if the row rhythm and ticks are timid.

options.label: Start-here path
options.lineage: a lesson plan on the board
options.thesis: A leader's first visit opens on a three-post path, chalk-connected, before the full feed.
options.viewport: "If you lead QA, start here" with three numbered posts joined by a chalk line, topic doors as a quiet row, the newest posts below.
options.risk: The path needs re-curating as better posts arrive.

options.label: Two-page spread
options.thesis: Desktop reads like an open notebook: who and what on the left page, the writing on the right.
options.viewport: Left page stays put with Ish, the three topics as a contents list and RSS/LinkedIn; right page scrolls the dated feed.
options.risk: On phones the spread stacks and becomes today's layout.
